summary: Adapter enforces mandatory skill-input readiness before preparation; backend hidden state and shell execution are forbidden; preparation requires declared slice plus nonempty contract/validator identities; lifecycle is ordered RED→GREEN→REFACTOR with RED failing expected test and test/docs-only paths, GREEN passing production-only paths, REFACTOR passing within production/tests/docs write set; invalid transitions block with RMAP rule IDs; finalization yields non-authoritative implementation candidate only after complete lifecycle; resume rejects stale identities and failed/stale/superseded runs; protocol bundle requires schema rmap.capsule-attempt-bundle.v1, exactly one context/attempt per stage, consistent STAGE-* bindings and hashes; persistence requires complete contained artifact set, immutable conflicts rejected, reparse points forbidden, observation files preserved; execute requires new run directory and paired bundle/store, writes recovery-state.v1 with no authorizations; acceptance/handoff/release remain unauthorized.
